description: Kenya - Evapotranspiration - African Horn is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Water", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This product provides information on the actual evapotranspiration (ET) on a coarse scale for the entire African Horn on the daily scale. The estimates are based on data from the Meteosat Second Generation SEVIRI sensor as well as some ancillary meteorological data. Coverage: Kenya. It has 0 files. The portal files it under Water. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
